name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Lets both parties share confidential information for a stated purpose, with obligations on use, protection and return of that information.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.example: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the MNDA takes effect

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: How long the MNDA lasts: a number of years from the Effective Date, or until terminated

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected: a number of years from the Effective Date (trade secrets stay protected while they remain trade secrets), or in perpetuity
fields.example: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the MNDA

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes
fields.example: Courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Any changes to the Standard Terms, or None

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term and termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the framework terms take effect

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: When the first Order Form starts

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long each subscription lasts before it renews

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How far before renewal a party must give notice to stop it renewing
fields.example: 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Customer pays and how it is billed
fields.example: $12,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance, due within 30 days

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: The support the Provider gives during the Subscription Period

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The maximum total liability of each party
fields.example: The fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider will defend the Customer against
fields.example: Claims that the Cloud Service infringes a third party's intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer will defend the Provider against
fields.example: Claims arising from Customer Content or the Customer's breach of the Restrictions

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: Any data processing agreement between the parties, or None

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes
fields.example: State or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable or on-premise software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: When the framework terms take effect

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: When the first Order Form starts

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long each license term lasts before it renews

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How far before renewal a party must give notice to stop it renewing
fields.example: 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.description: What the Customer may use the Software for

fields.label: License Limits
fields.description: Limits on use, such as seats, devices or instances

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Customer pays

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How fees are billed and paid
fields.example: Invoiced annually in advance, due within 30 days

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long the Provider warrants the Software will conform to its documentation

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.description: How the Customer removes the Software when the agreement ends
fields.example: Uninstall the Software and certify deletion in writing within 30 days

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Any extra warranties beyond the Standard Terms, or None

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The maximum total liability of each party for most claims
fields.example: The fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to a higher liability cap, or None

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: The higher cap for Increased Claims, or None

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, or None

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider will defend the Customer against
fields.example: Claims that the Software infringes a third party's intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer will defend the Provider against
fields.example: Claims arising from the Customer's use of the Software in breach of this Agreement

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes
fields.example: State or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level commitments for a cloud service, defining uptime targets, support response times, and service credits when targets are missed.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The cloud service agreement this SLA belongs to

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The subscription period the SLA covers

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: The monthly availability the Provider aims for

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: The service credit when uptime falls below target
fields.example: 10% of the monthly fees for the affected month

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance windows that do not count as downtime
fields.example: Up to 4 hours per month, with 48 hours' notice

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where the Customer sends support requests

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly the Provider aims to respond to support requests

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: The service credit when a response is late
fields.example: 5% of the monthly fees per missed response

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Governs a provider's processing of customer personal data, covering controller and processor roles, subprocessors, security, data subject requests, and international transfers.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement under which the Provider processes data

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What processing the Provider does and why
fields.example: Hosting and processing Customer data to provide the Cloud Service

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long the processing lasts
fields.example: For the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often personal data is transferred

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: The kinds of personal data processed

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Any sensitive data (health, biometric and so on), or None

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra safeguards for special category data, or None

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: The subprocessors the Customer approves, or where the list is published

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: The EU member state whose law governs the EU Standard Contractual Clauses

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The security standard the Provider is audited against

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Where to send security requests

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) for a covered entity.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement under which the Provider handles PHI

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: When the BAA takes effect

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How quickly the Provider must report a breach to the Company

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Any limits on how the Provider may use or disclose PHI, or None

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a services agreement governing the provider's AI services, including customer Input, generated Output, and limits on training models with customer data.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The services agreement this addendum belongs to

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Customer data the Provider may train models on, or None to forbid training

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What models may be trained for, or None

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Conditions on any training, or None
fields.example: Data must be de-identified before training

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on using Input and Output to improve the AI services without training, or None
